'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Aaron Kingery DS Separatist Uprising''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

2010 Players Committee sheet, deck name Why you hate Me?. Same 60 as the numbered list on [[2014 Worlds Day 3 Aaron Kingery DS Separatist Uprising]] (Day 3 is OUT/IN). Ditto marks expanded. (V) follows the sheet checkbox.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Separatist Uprising / At War With Itself]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
